title: Trajectory
description: A recorded agent run: ordered steps with lifted parameter slots, locator candidates, fingerprints, and optional post-condition placeholders. NEVER contains literal typed values, cookies, or storage.

trajectory_id.description: Stable id for this recording (uuid or slug).

site_key.description: Logical site identity, e.g. grafana-oss@10.2.0 — never a tenant hostname with customer data.

task_key.description: Logical task identity shared across recordings of the same workflow.

base_url_template.description: Base URL as a template with typed holes, e.g. http://{host}:{port}

parameters.description: Named typed slots lifted from inline values at capture time. Values are NEVER stored here — only name→type.

recorder.description: Recorder package version or git SHA.

agent_model.description: Model id used for the driving agent, or 'human' for manual capture.

strategy.description: Preference order for compiler fallback: role_name > label > testid > structural > text.

role.description: ARIA role from fixed vocabulary when strategy=role_name.

name.description: Accessible name TEMPLATE; may contain {param} holes, never tenant literals.

testid.description: data-testid value from allowlisted vocabulary only.

structural_path.description: Structural path (nth-child / landmark chain), no free-text attribute values.

text.description: Visible text TEMPLATE with typed holes.

css.description: CSS using only allowlisted attribute names (B5 vocabulary).

tenant_scoped.description: True if this candidate carries free text / tainted attrs and must not pool.

url_template.description: URL with path/query literals replaced by typed holes where tenant-specific.

dom_digest.description: Stable hash of allowlisted structural signals (roles, landmarks, counts) — never raw HTML.

param_refs.description: Parameter slot names consumed by this action (from trajectory.parameters).

key.description: For press actions: key name, not a secret.

url_template.description: For navigate: URL template with typed holes.

wait_ms.description: For wait actions: the recorded duration in milliseconds (ADR-0008). Absent means a bare settle hint, not an unspecified duration — see runner networkidle fallback.

intent.description: Human-readable purpose of the step (no tenant data).

locator_candidates.description: Ordered alternatives for the compiler; may be empty for navigate/wait.

assertion_hint.description: Optional recorder hint for B3 assertion synthesis; not authoritative.

post_action_target_visible.description: ADR-0007. Whether the element this step acted on was still visible immediately after the action, observed with Playwright's isVisible() — the same definition the runner later asserts with. Omitted when the step acted through no locator (navigate, wait). A false value lets the compiler assert the control disappeared instead of wrongly asserting it is still visible.

controls_appeared.description: ADR-0026 (#224). How many controls (role + accessible name, the repair context's own capture) were visible after the action that were not visible before it. A count only: no name is recorded. Omitted when either capture failed, never guessed as 0. Lets the compiler assert that a click revealed something, instead of the version-specific 'the clicked control is still visible'.
